subject: Business continuity evidence request — RTO/RPO snapshots & runbook
messages:
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@orbitpay.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: OrbitPay Security <security@orbitpay.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Business continuity evidence request — RTO/RPO snapshots & runbook

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — OrbitPay's compliance team is collecting evidence for our upcoming vendor review. We need a short packet covering Redwood's business continuity and disaster recovery posture. Specifically we're asking for:

- Current RTO and RPO targets (by offering: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private) and the last snapshot showing measured RTO/RPO from DR validation runs.
- The latest BCP/DR runbook (primary runbook + a short summary of escalation playbooks).
- Evidence of at least one DR drill or failover test in the last 12 months (logs, dates, owners).
- Any SOC 2 mapping or references used in your SIG/CAIQ responses for availability/resilience controls (redacted is fine).

Please confirm scope — we only need materials relevant to availability/resilience (not application-level design). Can you provide an initial packet by May 27? If you have a secure drive link we can download from, please share.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Ortiz
Senior Security Manager, OrbitPay
jenna.ortiz@orbitpay.com

Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear list. We're able to provide the items you requested. A couple quick clarifying questions:

- Do you need separate RTO/RPO entries for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, or is a single table acceptable if we call out variance by deployment type?
- Are there any specific redaction rules your team requires for the SOC 2 report (PII or customer identifiers)?

Plan: I'll assemble an initial packet and share a secure Drive link. We can deliver an initial set by Friday, May 22, and a fuller package (including drill logs) by Monday, May 25. If that works for you we can also schedule a technical walkthrough the week of May 25.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding OrbitPay's ask (below). Target deliverables and owners: 

- Rishi: please generate the RTO/RPO snapshot PDF per offering (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Include measured times from the last formal validation run (date-stamped) and short notes on how KV cache and live migrations affect recovery.
- Lauren: please extract the DR drill log entries for the last 12 months and prepare a redacted SOC 2 excerpt that maps to the CAIQ/SIG availability questions. Mark any items that are pending evidence.

I'll draft the cover email and share the Drive link once both artifacts are ready. We should aim for the initial packet by EOD May 22. If you hit blockers, escalate to me.

Thanks — Naomi

Hi Jenna — attaching the initial packet and a secure Drive link for the full set. Files attached here are redacted where needed; the Drive folder contains higher-fidelity logs behind our access controls.

Included in this packet (attachments + link):
- redwood_rto_rpo_snapshot_20260520.pdf — table of target RTO/RPO by offering and last measured recovery times (notes on measurement method).
- BCP_runbook_v2.pdf — primary BCP/DR runbook (executive summary + escalation playbooks).
- dr_drill_log_may2026.csv — condensed drill log with dates, owners, and outcome flags (sensitive customer IDs redacted).
- SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf — redacted SOC 2 Type II report excerpt mapping to availability and change-management controls.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/shared/OrbitPay/BCP-evidence-OP-2026-0042
HubSpot (deal): https://hubspot.example.com/deal/OP-2026-0042

Notes:
- Our RTO targets vary by deployment: Hosted (60s token latency targets, application-level recovery measured in minutes for edge routing), Dedicated (planned RTO ~15 minutes for compute failover with KV warmstart), Private (customer-managed networking adds variability; see PDF). The snapshot contains measured outcomes from our May 2026 validation.
- All files are encrypted at rest; Drive folder access is restricted to verified OrbitPay accounts. If you need an SFTP transfer or a signed NDA addendum, tell me and we'll arrange.

If you'd like, we can do a 30-minute walkthrough early next week to step through the runbook and drill evidence. 

Best,
Naomi Feldman
